questions.question: What does HTML stand for?
questions.explanation: HTML stands for Hyper Text Markup Language, the standard language for creating web pages.

questions.question: Which language is used to style web pages?
questions.explanation: CSS (Cascading Style Sheets) is used to style and layout web pages.

questions.question: Which language adds interactivity to web pages?
questions.explanation: JavaScript is used to add interactivity and dynamic behavior to web pages.

questions.question: Which HTML tag is used for the largest heading?
questions.explanation: <h1> defines the largest heading in HTML. Headings go from <h1> (largest) to <h6> (smallest).

questions.question: Which tag creates a hyperlink?
questions.explanation: The (anchor) tag is used to create hyperlinks. Example: Click here.

questions.question: Which attribute of the <a> tag specifies the destination URL?
questions.explanation: The href attribute specifies the URL the link points to.

questions.question: Which tag inserts an image?
questions.explanation: The tag is used to embed images. Example: .

questions.question: How do you change the text color to red in CSS?
questions.explanation: The CSS property 'color' changes the text color. Example: color: red;

questions.question: Which CSS property changes the background color?
questions.explanation: The background-color property sets the background color of an element.

questions.question: Which CSS selector targets elements with a specific class?
questions.explanation: A dot (.) prefix selects elements by class name. Example: .myClass { color: blue; }.

questions.question: Which CSS selector targets an element by its ID?
questions.explanation: A hash (#) prefix selects an element by its ID. Example: #myId { font-size: 20px; }.

questions.question: How do you display a message box in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: The alert() function displays a popup message box in the browser.

questions.question: Which keyword declares a variable in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: In JavaScript, 'var' (or 'let'/'const') is used to declare variables.

questions.question: Which method selects an HTML element by its ID in JavaScript?
questions.explanation: document.getElementById('id') returns the element with the specified ID.

questions.question: Which HTML tag contains the visible content of a web page?
questions.explanation: The <body> tag contains all the visible content of an HTML page.

questions.question: Which tag defines a paragraph in HTML?
questions.explanation:
The

tag defines a paragraph element in HTML.

questions.question: Sara wants to create a link that opens in a new tab. Which attribute should she add?
questions.explanation: The target='_blank' attribute opens the link in a new browser tab/window.

questions.question: Aisha wants to center a heading horizontally. Which CSS property achieves this?
questions.explanation: text-align: center; centers inline content horizontally within its parent element.

questions.question: Hassan wants to change the text of a paragraph when a button is clicked. Which method should he use?
questions.explanation: innerHTML (or textContent) can be used to change the content of an HTML element dynamically.

questions.question: What is the correct order of including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript in a web page?
options: JavaScript first, then CSS, then HTML
HTML first, then CSS, then JavaScript
CSS first, then JavaScript, then HTML
questions.explanation: HTML defines structure, CSS styles it, and JavaScript adds behavior — typically loaded in this order.
